title: datazoom.social: PNAD Contínua microdata and panels in R
text: load_pnadc function wrapper get_pnadc package PNADcIBGE, added identification algorithms panel construction. details identification algorithms, see vignette("BUILD_PNADC_PANEL"). Panel Structure: table shows first last quarter (ANOtrimestre, e.g. 20121 = 2012 Q1) covered PNADC rotating panel: Options: save_to: directory user desires save downloaded files. years: picks years data downloaded quarters: quarters within years downloaded. Can either vector 1:4 consistent quarters across years, list vectors, quarters different year (e.g. list(1:4, 1:2) four quarters first year two second). panel: panel algorithm apply data. five options: none: panel built. raw_data = TRUE, returns original data. Otherwise, creates extra treated variables. Quarterly files saved depending save_options. basic: Performs basic identification steps using household IDs, sex, exact dates birth. advanced_1: Performs Stage 1 advanced identification, imputing missing birth dates using within-household donors. advanced_2: Performs Stage 2 advanced identification, relaxing year birth constraint. advanced_3 (Recommended): Performs Stage 3 advanced identification, utilizing Graph Theory fuzzy matching fragmented interviews account typographical errors. raw_data: command define user like download raw treated data. two options: TRUE: want PNADC variables come. FALSE: want treated version PNADC variables. deflator: logical argument forwarded PNADcIBGE::get_pnadc(). TRUE (default): downloads deflator variables made available PNADcIBGE. FALSE: downloads microdata without deflator variables. defyear: deflator year forwarded PNADcIBGE::get_pnadc() annual microdata. ignored quarterly downloads used deflator = TRUE. defperiod: deflator period forwarded PNADcIBGE::get_pnadc() annual per-topic microdata. ignored quarterly downloads used deflator = TRUE. save_options: logical vector length 2 controlling file saving behaviour: c(TRUE, TRUE) (default): saves quarterly panel files .rds. c(FALSE, TRUE): save quarterly files; saves panel files .rds. c(TRUE, FALSE): saves quarterly panel files .parquet datasets. c(FALSE, FALSE): save quarterly files; saves panel files .parquet dataset. vars: character vector additional variable names download, following convention vars PNADcIBGE::get_pnadc(). Use NULL (default) download available microdata columns. See note regarding structural columns always returned PNADcIBGE::get_pnadc() regardless argument Details: function performs following steps: Loop years quarters using PNADcIBGE::get_pnadc download data. quarters collected memory saved depending save_options. Split data panels panel variable V1014. Apply identification algorithms defined build_pnadc_panel. Save panel files .rds .parquet, depending save_options. base identification logic build_pnadc_panel originally drawn Ribas, Rafael Perez, Sergei Suarez Dillon Soares (2008): “Sobre o painel da Pesquisa Mensal de Emprego (PME) IBGE”, extensive modernizations, missing-data imputation, graph-based fuzzy matching introduced Data Zoom team. Usage: Default: download PNADC data quarters 2022 2023, advanced fuzzy identification (Stage 3), simply run: download PNADC data 2022, first quarter 2023, run: download PNADC data without variables treatment identification (e.g., quarters 2021), run: download PNADC data without deflator variables supplied PNADcIBGE, run: download PNADC data, save quarters disk, save panels Parquet, run: download PNADC data save panels RDS discard quarterly files, run: download specific subset variables - example, age (V2009) habitual income (VD4019) - alongside structural columns PNADcIBGE always returns, run: download specific subset variables - example, age (V2009) habitual income (VD4019) - alongside structural columns PNADcIBGE always returns, run: (V1027, V1028, V1028001-V1028200, posest, posest_sxi) columns regardless vars argument. include survey design weights (V1027, V1028, V1028001-V1028200, posest, posest_sxi) identifiers UF, Estrato, V1029, V1033, ID_DOMICILIO. deflator = TRUE, deflator variables (Habitual, Efetivo) also included. vars argument adds columns top ; restrict . Use vars = NULL (default) download available microdata columns. Deflation: Deflation support load_pnadc() provided PNADcIBGE. deflator methodology deflator files , see PNADcIBGE::pnadc_deflator() corresponding documentation package. specify vars also request panel identification, columns # V2007, V20082, V20081, V2008 V2003 - added automatically added automatically warning tell ones added. example, using panel = "advanced_3", columns V2007, V20082, V20081, V2008, V2003 must present. omit vars, function adds :
code: load_pnadc(   save_to = getwd(),   years,   quarters = 1:4,   panel = "advanced_3",   raw_data = FALSE,   deflator = TRUE,   defyear = NULL,   defperiod = NULL,   save_options = c(TRUE, TRUE),   vars = NULL ) load_pnadc(   save_to = "Directory/You/Would/like/to/save/the/files",   years = 2022:2023,   panel = "advanced_3" ) load_pnadc(   save_to = "Directory/You/Would/like/to/save/the/files",   years = 2022:2023,   quarters = list(1:4, 1) ) load_pnadc(   save_to = "Directory/You/Would/like/to/save/the/files",   years = 2021,   panel = "none",   raw_data = TRUE ) load_pnadc(   save_to = "Directory/You/Would/like/to/save/the/files",   years = 2022,   deflator = FALSE ) load_pnadc(   save_to = "Directory/You/Would/like/to/save/the/files",   years = 2022,   save_options = c(TRUE, FALSE) ) load_pnadc(   save_to = "Directory/You/Would/like/to/save/the/files",   years = 2022,   save_options = c(FALSE, TRUE) ) load_pnadc(   save_to = "Directory/You/Would/like/to/save/the/files",   years = 2022,   vars = c("V2009", "VD4019") ) # Only V2009 requested, but panel = "advanced_3" needs # V2007, V20082, V20081, V2008 and V2003 - these are added automatically # with a warning. load_pnadc(   save_to = "Directory/You/Would/like/to/save/the/files",   years = 2022,   panel = "advanced_3",   vars = c("V2009", "VD4019") )

code: load_pnadc(   save_to,   years,   quarters = 1:4,   panel = "advanced",   raw_data = FALSE,   deflator = TRUE,   defyear = NULL,   defperiod = NULL,   save_options = c(TRUE, TRUE),   vars = NULL )

title: Load Continuous PNAD Data — load_pnadc
text: save_to character directory save downloaded files. years numeric indicating years data loaded, format YYYY. Can vector numbers, 2010:2012. quarters quarters within years downloaded. Can numeric vector list vectors, different quarters per year. panel character choosing panel algorithm apply ("none", "basic", "advanced"). details, check vignette("BUILD_PNADC_PANEL") raw_data logical setting return raw (TRUE) processed (FALSE) variables. deflator logical passed get_pnadc. TRUE (default), deflator variables supplied PNADcIBGE included downloaded microdata. defyear deflator year passed get_pnadc annual microdata. argument ignored quarterly downloads used deflator = TRUE. See get_pnadc details. defperiod deflator period passed get_pnadc annual per-topic microdata. argument ignored quarterly downloads used deflator = TRUE. See get_pnadc details. save_options logical vector length 2. Controls whether quarterly files saved format files saved. Panel files always saved. four possible combinations: c(TRUE, TRUE): saves quarterly panel files .rds format. default. c(TRUE, FALSE): saves quarterly panel files .parquet format. c(FALSE, TRUE): save quarterly files; panel files saved .rds format. c(FALSE, FALSE): save quarterly files; panel files saved .parquet format. vars character vector additional variable names downloaded, following convention vars parameter get_pnadc. name must match column PNADC microdata exactly published IBGE (e.g. "VD4019", "V2009"). Note get_pnadc always returns set structural columns regardless argument, include survey design weights (V1027, V1028, V1028001, V1028200, posest, posest_sxi) identifiers UF, Estrato, V1029, V1033, ID_DOMICILIO, totalling around 210 columns. deflator = TRUE, deflator variables (Habitual, Efetivo) also included. vars argument adds top columns; restrict . Use NULL (default) download available microdata columns. Deflation support wrapper provided PNADcIBGE. deflator methodology deflator files , see pnadc_deflator package. panel "none", columns required panel identification algorithm missing vars added automatically warning list columns added. required columns per algorithm : "basic": UPA, V1008, V1014, V2007, V20082, V20081, V2008. "advanced": , plus V2003. Note several (UPA, V1008, V1014) part structural columns always returned get_pnadc, practice V2007, V20082, V20081, V2008 (V2003 "advanced") likely auto-added.

title: Simulated PNAD sample dataset — pnad_sample
text: data.table data.frame 31 rows 23 variables: V1 Record identifier. Ano Survey year. Trimestre Survey quarter. UF Federative unit code. UPA Primary sampling unit identifier. V1008 Household serial identifier. V1014 Number household members. V1016 Household interview status type code. V20082 Year birth. V20081 Month birth. V2008 Day birth age-related auxiliary code, provided simulated data. V2007 Sex code. V2009 Age years. VD3004 Educational attainment code. VD4001 Labor force status code. VD4002 Employment status code. VD4005 Employment position job category code. VD4009 Usual hours worked category related labor variable code. VD4019 Monthly labor income. V4010 Main job identifier occupation-related code. V4012 Economic activity occupation grouping code. V4013 Time job age-related auxiliary labor code. V4022 Household person weight, represented simulated data.

title: Simulated PNAD sample dataset — pnad_sample
text: dataset contain real PNAD observations. created demonstration purposes includes small subset variables original files distributed IBGE. reduced size makes package examples faster lighter, preserving structure similar original survey data. purpose pnad_sample provide lightweight object mimics part structure PNAD Contínua microdata, allowing users run examples without downloading processing full original files. Variable names follow naming convention used original survey microdata, values dataset simulated used substantive empirical analysis.
